turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's karaoke night on Friday and I need to choose a song.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm going to list all the options first, so please don't comment until I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a big power ballad that everyone loves, but the high notes are brutal.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a cheesy duet I could do with my sister, which would be a laugh.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one is a rock anthem with a huge chorus the whole pub can shout along to.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, that's all. Which sounds best to you?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Are you after glory or fun? For fun, do the duet or the anthem. If you're feeling brave after a drink or two, try the ballad later in the night, when everyone's warmed up.
